verse.verse_1: I do call to witness this City;-
verse.verse_2: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
verse.verse_3: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
verse.verse_4: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
verse.verse_5: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
verse.verse_6: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
verse.verse_7: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
verse.verse_8: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
verse.verse_9: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
verse.verse_10: And shown him the two highways?
verse.verse_11: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
verse.verse_12: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
verse.verse_14: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
verse.verse_15: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
verse.verse_16: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
verse.verse_17: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
verse.verse_18: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
verse.verse_19: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
verse.verse_20: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
